name: python-rag-eval
title: Python RAG evaluation
blurb: A retrieval evaluation harness that produces numbers you can defend: BM25 over overlapping chunk windows, documents deduplicated before scoring, precision divided by k, unjudged queries reported as skipped, macro and micro recall side by side, and a compare gate that exits 1 when a change makes retrieval worse
default_description: An offline retrieval evaluation harness whose metrics survive review, with a compare gate for CI.
